## NativeBodyOptions.identifierAliases property

Add the legacy identifier aliases to list items: the identifier value under the stable key `id`<!-- -->, and, when a resource is matched on a working property instead of its declared identifier, that property's value mirrored into the declared identifier field.

Only operations whose output passes through unconverted want these: their callers pass `item.id` back as the `id` request parameter. A typed output contract declares its record fields exactly and derives references from the record itself. Its encode silently drops undeclared keys such as `id`<!-- -->, but a mirrored identifier field is declared, so encode would accept it holding another property's value. A typed body must therefore produce only the declared fields, each holding its own value. Defaults to `false`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly identifierAliases?: boolean;
```
